content.comment_body: I have added some user-selectable options to let the operator enable or disable specific parts of the PLC code. During setup or use, they select 'Set Parameters' and toggle these options, for example, to deactivate a second pump if it's not installed. How can I simulate these options in [product_name] simulation?
Review the attached file. Position the cursor on the output of the user options, then right-click. A menu will pop up with choices.
Thank you. It wasn't clear how to do this, but after your explanation, I got it working. Appreciate the help.
This method also applies to other features like network inputs and outputs of counters, timers, and similar components.
